sb.name: Glacier Bulette
sb.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Ice Walk
traits.desc: The bulette can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Steam Aura
traits.desc: At the end of each of the bulette's turns, each creature of the bulette's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the bulette takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage unless the bulette has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The bulette can burrow through solid ice and leaves a slick, 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Eruption (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: If the bulette is burrowed no more than 20 feet deep in solid ice, it spends 5 feet of movement to burrow directly upward, emerging from the ice and jumping to a space within 5 feet of where it emerged. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the space where the bulette emerged or its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the bulette emerged or its destination space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The winged wretch makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Thunderous Shriek (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The winged wretch emits a cacophonous wave of energy. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargoyle makes two attacks, using Claw or Ice Dart in any combination.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ice Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Death Flash
traits.desc: The invisiboar emits a bright flash of light when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the invisiboar. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

traits.name: Invisible
traits.desc: The invisiboar always has the Invisible condition unless it's in the area of an [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|Antimagic Field]] spell or similar effect.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Dendallen makes four attacks, using Staff or Chilling Ray in any combination. He can (A) replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|Magic Missile]] or (B) replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]] (level 5 version).

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Force damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Chilling Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Dendallen casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|Darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|Magic Missile]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]] (level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Circle Of Death|Circle of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|Cloudkill]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|Finger of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Spray|Prismatic Spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Weird|Weird]]

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Dendallen casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

sb.name: Risen Sporehusk
sb.senses: Blindsight 15 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 7
sb.languages: understands Common plus one other language it knew but can't speak

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The sporehusk regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the sporehusk takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Grab
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. (must target a creature Grappled by the sporehusk). Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

sb.name: Scout Sporehusk
sb.senses: Blindsight 15 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 7

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The sporehusk regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function on the sporehusk's next turn. The sporehusk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the sporehusk has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Grab
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. (must target a creature Grappled by the sporehusk). Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

sb.name: Spirit of Dendallen
sb.damage_resistances: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Truesight 15 ft., passive Perception 21
sb.languages: Common plus three other languages; telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Attuned Thrall
traits.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 21, the creature that attuned to three Remnants of Dendallen (if the creature has Immunity to the Charmed condition or can't be possessed, it can still be affected, but it makes its saves against this effect with Advantage). Failure: The target has the Charmed condition, becoming the host to the Spirit of Dendallen. On the spirit's turn, it can issue verbal or telepathic commands to the target (no action required). The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from the spirit, it acts and moves as it likes, seemingly unaware of or unbothered by the presence of the spirit. The spirit can also command the target to take a Reaction but must take its own Reaction to do so. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect and dismissing the spirit on a success. The DC for this save decreases when the spirit drops to certain Hit Point thresholds, reducing by 1 at 150 HP (DC 20), 100 HP (DC 19), and 50 HP (DC 18).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The spirit can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Incorporeal Tether
traits.desc: The spirit can't move on its own. Instead, as the spirit's host moves, the spirit is moved with it (remaining centered on the host), even through other creatures and objects. The spirit can occupy another creature's space and vice versa.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the spirit fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The spirit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Persistent Tendrils
traits.desc: If the spirit doesn't have any tendrils at the end of its turn, one Tendril of Dendallen is created, as if by the Create Tendrils action.

traits.name: Unstable Conduit
traits.desc: If the spirit's host dies, the spirit is destroyed in an explosion of necromantic energy, and the host is disintegrated into gray dust, leaving behind any Remnants of Dendallen it was wearing or carrying. The host can be revived only by a [[Tools/Spells/True Resurrection|True Resurrection]] or a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the host. Failure: 33 (6d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes two attacks, using Slam or Decaying Ray in any combination. It can (A) replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|Magic Missile]] (level 2 version) or (B) replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]] (level 9 version).

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Force damage plus 11 (2d10) Acid damage.

actions.name: Decaying Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +13, range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, taking 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage on a failure or losing all Exhaustion levels caused by this effect on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Create Tendrils (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The spirit creates 1d4 + 2 Tendrils of Dendallen, each appearing in unoccupied spaces the spirit can see on solid surfaces within 150 feet of itself. The spirit can have no more than six tendrils at a time. The tendrils take their turns immediately after the spirit on the same Initiative count, and they obey the spirit. A tendril remains for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The spirit casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|Darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/False Life|False Life]] (level 3 version), [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]] (level 3 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|Magic Missile]] (level 2 version)
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]] (level 9 version), [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|Finger of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|Cloudkill]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Circle Of Death|Circle of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Spray|Prismatic Spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Weird|Weird]]

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.desc: The spirit casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] or [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]] in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Accursed Magic
legendary_actions.desc: The spirit uses Spellcasting to cast [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]], [[Tools/Spells/False Life|False Life]] (level 3 version), or [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]] (level 3 version). The spirit can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Command Tendrils
legendary_actions.desc: Up to two Tendrils of Dendallen the spirit can see each either make a Grasp attack or use [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]]. The spirit can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Sweep
legendary_actions.desc: The spirit sweeps out with its massive arm. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 20-foot Cone. Failure: 23 (3d12 + 4) Force damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the spirit and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the swordbeak moved 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Slashing damage.

sb.name: Tendril of Dendallen
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, psychic, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, poisoned, restrained, unconscious

actions.name: Immovable
actions.desc: The tendril can't move or be moved except via teleportation or interplanar travel.

actions.name: Immutable Form
actions.desc: The tendril can't shape-shift.

actions.name: Necromantic Demise
actions.desc: The tendril disappears if the Spirit of Dendallen is destroyed or dismissed.

actions.name: Will of Dendallen
actions.desc: The tendril has a telepathic link with the spirit and the spirit's host while it's on the same plane of existence as them. The tendril doesn't provide cover to enemies against attacks and effects that pass through its space.

actions.name: Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Force damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is pulled up to 5 feet toward the tendril. The tendril can have only one target Grappled in this way at a time.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: The tendril throws a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The tendril teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see on a solid surface.

sb.name: Weremammoth
sb.speed: 30 ft., 40 ft. (hybrid form only), 50 ft. (mammoth form only)

traits.name: Adapted
traits.desc: The weremammoth can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without being subjected to the effects of extreme cold.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The weremammoth makes three attacks, using Spear or Trample in any combination. It can replace one attack with a Gore attack.

actions.name: Gore (Mammoth or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a Weremammoth under the GM's control and has 10 Hit Points. Success: The target is immune to this weremammoth's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Trample (Mammoth or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the weremammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The werewolf shape-shifts into a Large mammoth-humanoid hybrid or a Huge mammoth, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

sb.name: White Wraith
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Blizzard Stalker
traits.desc: Inclement weather (such as fog, snow or wind) doesn't impede the wraith's vision, and it has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in such conditions.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Necrotic damage plus 16 (3d10) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

actions.name: Freezing Gale (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Create Walker (2/Day)
actions.desc: The wraith targets a Humanoid corpse within 10 feet of itself that died from either Cold damage or exposure to extreme cold. The target's remains animate as either a Skeleton or a Zombie (depending on the state of the corpse, as determined by the GM) that has Immunity to Cold and Necrotic damage and shares the wraith's Blizzard Stalker trait. The animated creature is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than ten animated creatures under its control at a time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The winged wretch makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Slashing damage.
